earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 a3q2026elvearningsrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document E A R N I N G S R E L E A S E ELEVANCE HEALTH REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS; RAISES FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE • 3Q 2026 operating revenue of $50.4 billion, up 0.7% from 3Q 2025 • 3Q 2026 diluted EPS 1 of $6.27 and adjusted diluted EPS 2 of $6.99; results reflect improved operating performance and a net non-operating benefit of $1.85 per share • FY 2026 diluted EPS 1 guidance raised to at least $22.00; adjusted diluted EPS 2 guidance raised to at least $29.00 on continued operating momentum • FY 2026 operating cash flow guidance raised to at least $6.5 billion • Investing in capabilities that improve the member experience, strengthen our competitive advantage, and support long-term growth Indianapolis, IN - October 21, 2026 - Elevance Health, Inc. (NYSE: ELV) reported third quarter 2026 results ahead of expectations. "Elevance Health's third quarter results reflect stronger execution across our diversified portfolio and underscore the earnings power of the business. We are raising our 2026 earnings outlook and remain confident in delivering at least 12% growth in adjusted diluted earnings per share in 2027 from our higher earnings baseline of at least $26.75 3 . By bringing together the capabilities of our Health Benefits business and Carelon, we are improving the healthcare experience, strengthening our competitive advantage, and creating long-term value for our shareholders." Gail K. Boudreaux President and Chief Executive Officer 1. Earnings per diluted share ("EPS"). 2. See "GAAP Reconciliation" on pages 13 and 14 herein. 3. Adjusted Operating Gain for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 excludes items that are excluded from adjusted shareholders' net income. See "GAAP Reconciliation" on pages 13 and 14 herein. Operating revenue was $50.4 billion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $0.4 billion compared to the prior year quarter. This was driven by higher premium yields, increased CarelonRx product revenue, and growth in service fees, partially offset by lower Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Employer Group risk membership. The benefit expense ratio of 90.6 percent improved 70 basis points, driven by better performance in Medicare Advantage and Individual ACA compared to the prior year. Days in Claims Payable stood at 44.9 days as of September 30, 2026, an increase of 3.5 days year over year. The operating expense ratio was 11.4 percent. The adjusted operating expense ratio was 11.3 percent, an increase of 90 basis points from the prior year. The increase principally reflected targeted, one-time investments in capabilities that support our long-term performance, along with spending to advance business growth and quality initiatives. Cash Flow & Balance Sheet Operating cash flow of $1.3 billion in the quarter increased $0.1 billion relative to the prior year, primarily reflecting favorable working capital dynamics. As of September 30, 2026, cash and investments at the parent company totaled approximately $2.4 billion. During the third quarter of 2026, the Company repurchased 0.8 million shares of its common stock for $330 million, at a weighted average price of $398.75 per share, and paid a quarterly dividend of $1.72 per share, representing a distribution of cash totaling $373 million. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had approximately $5.0 billion of Board approved share repurchase authorization remaining. 2 Health Benefits is comprised of Individual, Employer Group risk-based, Employer Group fee-based, BlueCard ® , Medicare, Medicaid, and Federal Employee Program businesses. Health Benefits Reportable Segment Highlights (Unaudited) (In billions) Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 September 30, 2025 Operating Revenue 1 $43.4 $42.2 Operating Gain 1 $0.4 $0.6 Operating Margin 1 1.0 % 1.4 % 1. See “Basis of Presentation” on page 5 herein. Health Benefits segment operating revenue was $43.4 billion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $1.1 billion, or 3 percent compared to the prior year quarter, driven primarily by higher premium yields and service fee revenue, partially offset by lower Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Employer Group risk membership. Operating gain was $0.4 billion, a decline year over year, reflecting the impact of targeted investments to support our long-term operating model. This was partially offset by the improvement in our benefit expense ratio. Medical membership of approximately 44.9 million as of September 30, 2026 decreased by 487 thousand compared to the prior year. The decline reflected lower enrollment in our Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and Employer Group risk-based businesses, partially offset by growth in Commercial fee-based membership. 3 Carelon is comprised of CarelonRx and Carelon Services. Carelon Reportable Segment Highlights (Unaudited) (In billions) Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 September 30, 2025 Operating Revenue 1 $19.3 $18.3 Operating Gain 1 $0.9 $0.8 Operating Margin 1 4.7 % 4.2 % 1. See “Basis of Presentation” on page 5 herein. Operating revenue for Carelon was $19.3 billion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $1.0 billion, or 5 percent compared to the prior year quarter. Growth was driven by CarelonRx product revenue and continued expansion of Carelon Services risk-based solutions. Operating gain for Carelon totaled $0.9 billion, an increase of 17 percent year over year, reflecting strong performance of Carelon Services risk-based solutions and the improved profitability of our specialty pharmacy. 4 Quarterly Dividend On October 20, 2026, the Audit Committee of the Company's Board of Directors declared a fourth quarter 2026 dividend to shareholders of $1.72 per share. The fourth quarter dividend is payable on December 18, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026. About Elevance Health Elevance Health is a lifetime, trusted health partner whose purpose is to improve the health of humanity. The company supports consumers, families, and communities across the entire healthcare journey – connecting them to the care, support, and resources they need to lead better lives. Elevance Health’s companies serve approximately 103 million consumers through a diverse portfolio of industry-leading medical, pharmacy, behavioral, clinical, home health, and complex care solutions. For more information, please visit www.elevancehealth.com or follow us @ElevanceHealth on X and Elevance Health on LinkedIn. Conference Call and Webcast Management will host a conference call and webcast today at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time (“EDT”) to discuss the company’s third quarter results and outlook. The conference call should be accessed at least 15 minutes prior to the start of the call with the following numbers: 888-947-9963 (Domestic) 800-391-9853 (Domestic Replay) 312-470-0178 (International) 203-369-3269 (International Replay) The access code for today's conference call is 3972058. There is no access code for the replay. The replay will be available from 11:30 a.m. EDT today, until the end of the day on November 20, 2026. The call will also be available through a live webcast at www.elevancehealth.com under the “Investors” link. A webcast replay will be available following the call. Basis of Presentation 1. Operating gain/loss is calculated as total operating revenue less benefit expense, cost of products sold and operating expense. It does not include net investment income, net gains/losses on financial instruments, interest expense, amortization of other intangible assets, gains/losses on extinguishment of debt or income taxes, as these items are managed in a corporate shared service environment and are not the responsibility of operating segment management. reference.summary: Elevance Health, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a health benefits company in the United States. The company operates in four segments: Health Benefits, CarelonRx, Carelon Services, and Corporate & Other. It offers a variety of health plans and services to individual, employer group risk-based and fee-based, BlueCard, Medicare, Medicaid, and FEP members; health products; a broad array of fee-based administrative managed care services; and specialty and other insurance products and services, such as stop loss, dental, vision, and supplemental health insurance benefits.
